title: Bound versioned SFace Photo preprocessing and select detection scales
purpose: Bound high-resolution photographer detection cost and investigate useful second-scale coverage without changing native query/Buffalo or historical revision semantics.
success_outcome: New explicit SFace Photo preprocessing aligns original pixels after bounded detection and chooses 640 versus 640+1280 from repeatable real-sample evidence; query crops and legacy revisions retain their own single-pass behavior.

constraints: Primary owner processing, src/face_moment/processing/. Reuse the two direct adapters and Photo orchestrator; current query methods call process_photo, so separate their single-pass native route before adding Photo scale selection. No new FaceEngine abstraction is needed.

Read versioned-photographer-preprocessing and photographer-scale-experiment exact sections. Existing opencv-bgr-v1 and other historical configured preprocessing labels preserve old full-image behavior; new behavior is an exact explicit opt-in. Version identifies Photo behavior plus retained single-pass query path. Runtime model identity checks remain exact.

Decode EXIF once for inference. Both scales derive from the same oriented original. Reusing that decoded array in derivative generation is permitted within processing; preserve derivative output/original bytes. Clip published edge bbox after native original-pixel alignment; preserve mapped five-point landmarks.

Implement the paired-scale candidate as the same bounded adapter algorithm, not a second service. Production may retain only the selected exact new version if 1280 is not useful; a local benchmark override/helper may supply the experimental edges without changing legacy default behavior. Record the selected version and evidence.

Native sample inputs: /tmp/!datasets/serg_1/me_1/*.jpg (five), /tmp/!datasets/serg_1/IMG_20230523_185218.jpg (sixth), and root group JPEGs FansChildrenTJ.jpg / sirious-guys.jpg. Groups are local benchmark inputs only, not uploaded/admitted. Model files under models/opencv_sface are read-only.

Preserve deterministic geometry/readiness tests as regressions without adopting dependency claims. Exercise both new and legacy admission identities for serving and Calibration with matching/mismatched settings. No database migration or runtime persistence is introduced; native arrays and task-owned measurement artifacts suffice.

Use existing pytest fixtures with isolated databases/assets and cleanup for any integration test. Do not require real camera Attempts or operator ground truth that do not exist; report available matching/self-query evidence and its limits.

If host .env.local PostgreSQL forwarding is unavailable, the same exact focused pytest nodes may execute inside the source-mounted local backend container with its effective local environment; prove it runs current workspace source and fixture-owned isolated databases/object prefixes. This is an equivalent test invocation, not permission to mutate operator rows.
invariants: Original JPEG bytes, Photo identity/visibility/admission lineage and old revision outcomes remain unchanged.
Processing alone owns revision/state/faces/derivatives; serving_control alone selects serving; no foreign direct writes, fallback, extra worker or service.
